objective: Reemitir Gate13A readiness integral backend/SQL/repositorio de Cavas corrigiendo exclusivamente las consultas READ_ONLY para usar el esquema canonico real: CavaSocios_Botellas, CavaSocios_Movimientos y CavaSocios_Cargos. Mantener mismo alcance funcional de Dashboard, Socios, Persona-Link, Botellas, Inventario, Consumos, Kardex, reportes, permisos, multiunidad y errores. No mutar datos, codigo ni Produccion.

queries.name: gate13a_r3_candidate
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS UnidadNegocioID,NumeroSocio,Estatus,Activo,PersonaID,ClienteCRMID FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C');

queries.name: gate13a_r3_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios) AS socios,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas) AS botellas,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos) AS movimientos,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos) AS cargos,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona) AS personas,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo) AS persona_vinculos;

queries.name: gate13a_r3_rbac
queries.sql: SELECT urc.UsuarioID,urc.RolID,CONVERT(varchar(36),urc.UnidadNegocioID) AS UnidadNegocioID,urc.EmpresaID,urc.Activo FROM dbo.Usuario_RolesContexto urc WHERE urc.UsuarioID=4 AND urc.Activo=1;

queries.name: gate13a_r3_fk
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS child_table,fk.name,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk WHERE fk.parent_object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Socios'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Botellas'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos')) ORDER BY child_table,fk.name;

constraints: No user role permission menu company or unit changes
Frontend build certification remains a separate Gate13A component
Gate13B remains blocked until backend readiness and frontend build certification both pass
